dispositions.decision: Retain isolated writers as an optional, fail-closed Topology capability; do not make it the default or claim Stable without formal native evidence.
dispositions.trigger: Revisit Stable promotion only after a retained native host packet proves isolated writes, unauthorized-write denial, independent result acceptance, and recovery on the claimed platform.

dispositions.decision: Keep mutation verification as a bounded development/field-hardening gate; do not make it a general runtime subsystem.
dispositions.trigger: Reassess if field evidence shows it catches no distinct detector gap or duplicates another required gate.

dispositions.decision: Do not add a universal persisted pipeline/revision subsystem; retain current AuthorityRef, StateIdentity, and OpenSpec boundaries.
dispositions.trigger: Reopen when Harness Rig has persistent approved execution plans and a real workflow requires plan revision pinning or requirement-to-verification traceability.

dispositions.decision: Do not add a second authoring language without repeated measured duplication in stable plan artifacts.
dispositions.trigger: Reopen after repeated authoring duplication is observed in stable artifacts and a compile-away design can keep composition out of approval/runtime.

dispositions.decision: Keep the current minimum topology family; do not admit conditional branches, loops, fan-out, map/reduce, or compensation speculatively.
dispositions.trigger: Reopen one topology family at a time when a recurring authorized workflow cannot be expressed safely with current direct/worker formations and evidence demonstrates distinct value.

dispositions.decision: Do not add remote execution, shared storage, leases, or partition/recovery machinery without a real cross-host product workflow.
dispositions.trigger: Reopen when an approved customer workflow requires cross-host execution and identity, transport, shared durability, lease, partition, replay, and recovery requirements are evidenced.

dispositions.decision: Keep only minimal diagnostics/audit for routing, gate failures, freshness, host degradation, and migration; defer generic telemetry and external-effect workflow infrastructure.
dispositions.trigger: Reopen diagnostics on an observed decision-relevant evidence gap; reopen external effects only if Harness Rig is explicitly authorized to execute such effects.

dispositions.decision: Keep Claude as a secondary, host-specific experimental qualification target; do not infer support or make it a 1.0 blocker after Codex is genuinely Stable.
dispositions.trigger: Run native Claude qualification after the Codex primary baseline is retained and an authorized Claude environment is available; promote only from recorded discovery/invocation/runtime evidence.
